source: Provincial Department of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries, Pursat Province — សារធាតុចិញ្ចឹមសម្រាប់ដំណាំស្រូវ (Nutrients for the Rice Crop), presenter Yem Sophy, 20 Nov 2017, p.4-5
text: Organic fertilizer (ជីសរីរាង្គ) is fertilizer produced from decomposed organic material, including plant residue, animal waste/manure, green manure, and compost. Organic fertilizer's nutrient content is limited/dilute compared to chemical (inorganic) fertilizer, meaning larger quantities are generally needed to supply an equivalent amount of nutrients to the crop.
